no_adcom_quote.quote: There are no plans to present this application to the Oncology Drugs Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Dacogen (decitabine) NDA021790 original approval. The Medical Review's dedicated section 8.5 (Advisory Committee Meeting) states twice that there were no plans to present this application to the Oncology Drugs Advisory Committee. The only ODAC-related references in the record are the use of ODAC consultants in sponsor/FDA pre-NDA meetings and a general March 2003 ODAC meeting on MDS endpoints, neither of which was an advisory committee meeting that voted on this application; thus there are no AdComm-to-change linkages.
